### 二、十大深层问题与解决方案

#### 问题1：内存层级利用不精细

**问题描述**：
柔性引擎目前只按“数据大小”选择标量/SIMD/GPU，没有感知L1/L2/L3缓存的边界。当数据从几百KB跳到几十MB时，Cache Miss会导致性能断崖式下降。

**解决方案**：三级缓存感知调度器


```
cpp
// cache_aware_scheduler.h
#include <x86intrin.h>

class CacheAwareScheduler {
public:
    // 获取各缓存大小（运行时检测）
    void detect() {
        int reg[4];
        __cpuid(reg, 0x80000006);
        l2Size_ = (reg[2] >> 16) * 1024;   // L2 size in bytes
        l3Size_ = (reg[3] >> 18) * 512 * 1024; // L3 size in bytes
    }

    // 根据数据大小自动选择合适的执行策略
    void executeAdaptive(std::vector<Hexagram19683>& data) {
        size_t dataBytes = data.size() * sizeof(Hexagram19683);

        if (dataBytes <= l1Size_ / 2) {
            // 完全在L1内：使用极激进的内联展开
            processWithUnroll(data, 16);
        } else if (dataBytes <= l2Size_ / 2) {
            // 在L2内：使用缓存线对齐的批处理
            processWithPrefetch(data);
        } else if (dataBytes <= l3Size_ / 2) {
            // 在L3内：使用NUMA感知的多线程分块
            processWithNUMA(data);
        } else {
            // 超出缓存：使用流式处理，避免污染缓存
            processStreaming(data);
        }
    }
};

```


---

#### 问题2：缺少ARM SVE和RISC-V向量支持

**问题描述**：
当前支持的指令集仅限于 x86（SSE/AVX2/AVX-512）和 ARM NEON。缺少对现代 ARM SVE（Scalable Vector Extension，可变长向量扩展）和 RISC-V Vector 的支持。苹果M系列芯片、AWS Graviton 服务器、未来RISC-V设备都无法发挥最佳性能。

**解决方案**：SVE和RISC-V向量后端


```
cpp
// sve_backend.h - ARM SVE 后端
#ifdef __ARM_FEATURE_SVE
#include <arm_sve.h>

// SVE向量长度在运行时确定（128-2048位），一次可处理 64-1024 个 Trit
void evolveSVE(std::vector<Hexagram19683>& data, double chaos) {
    size_t vecLen = svcntb(); // 向量字节数
    size_t batch = vecLen / 2; // 每个Trit占2bit，每字节4个

    for (size_t i = 0; i < data.size(); i += batch) {
        svbool_t pg = svwhilelt_b64(i, data.size());

        // 加载、处理、存储（SVE自动适配向量长度）
        svuint8_t trits = svld1(pg, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&data[i]));
        svuint8_t evolved = tritonEvolveSVE(trits, chaos);
        svst1(pg, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&data[i]), evolved);
    }
}
#endif

```


**性能预估**：
在AWS Graviton3（SVE 256-bit）上可获得 4-8x 提升。
在富士通A64FX（SVE 512-bit）上可获得 16-32x 提升。

---

#### 问题3：温度保护策略过于简单

**问题描述**：
当前温度保护仅基于阈值线性降频，没有考虑：
- 负载类型（计算密集型 vs 访存密集型）的不同发热特性
- 多芯片封装的温度耦合
- 主动散热 vs 被动散热的差异
- 电池供电时的功耗约束

**解决方案**：智能化温度管理


```
cpp
// 增强的温度管理
class AdvancedThermalManager {
    double predictTemp(double currentTemp, double load, double duration) {
        // 简化热模型：T(t) = T_ambient + (T_max - T_ambient) * (1 - e^(-t/τ))
        double tau = thermalTimeConstant_; // 热时间常数（秒）
        double steadyState = ambientTemp_ + load * thermalResistance_;
        return currentTemp + (steadyState - currentTemp) * (1 - exp(-duration / tau));
    }

    void optimizeForBattery(double remainingPercent) {
        if (remainingPercent < 20) {
            // 切换到超低功耗模式：仅使用标量计算，降低频率
            maxIntensity_ = 0.1;
        }
    }
};

```


---

#### 问题4：缺少功耗封顶机制

**问题描述**：
目前无法限制最大功耗。在笔记本电池供电或数据中心TDP受限时，灵助可能耗尽资源。

**解决方案**：
集成 RAPL（Running Average Power Limit，Intel/AMD的功耗限制接口）和 nvidia-smi，实现动态功耗封顶。


```
cpp
// power_cap.h
class PowerCap {
    void setPowerLimit(double watts) {
        // Intel RAPL
        #ifdef __linux__
        std::ofstream rapl("/sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl/intel-rapl:0/constraint_0_power_limit_uw");
        if (rapl) rapl << static_cast<uint64_t>(watts * 1e6);
        #endif
        // NVIDIA
        #ifdef HAS_CUDA
        nvmlDeviceSetPowerManagementLimit(device, watts * 1000);
        #endif
    }
};

```


---

#### 问题5：缺少防降级攻击保护

**问题描述**：
恶意程序可以伪造硬件特性标志（如CPUID），诱使灵助使用不存在的指令集，导致崩溃或降级到低性能模式。

**解决方案**：
指令集实际可用性验证。


```
cpp
bool verifySIMD() {
    // 不仅仅检查CPUID，还要实际执行一条指令并验证结果
    if (cpuHasAVX512) {
        __m512i test = _mm512_set1_epi32(0x12345678);
        __m512i result = _mm512_add_epi32(test, test);
        return (_mm512_extract_epi32(result, 0) == 0x2468ACF0);
    }
    return false;
}

```


---

#### 问题6：缺少侧信道攻击防护

**问题描述**：
卦象流转的计算时间与π坐标和e呼吸节律相关。攻击者可能通过计时攻击推断当前的卦象状态，从而预测系统行为。

**解决方案**：恒定时间执行。


```
cpp
// constant_time_trit_ops.h
// 所有三进制运算必须使用恒定时间实现
Trit MidConstantTime(Trit a, Trit b) {
    // 使用位运算而非分支，确保执行时间恒定
    int8_t va = static_cast<int8_t>(a);
    int8_t vb = static_cast<int8_t>(b);
    int8_t aIsHe = (va == 0) ? 0xFF : 0x00;
    int8_t bIsHe = (vb == 0) ? 0xFF : 0x00;
    int8_t equal = (va == vb) ? 0xFF : 0x00;

    // 结果 = (任一为HE ? HE : (相等 ? a : HE))
    int8_t anyHe = aIsHe | bIsHe;
    int8_t result = (anyHe & 0x00) | ((~anyHe) & ((equal & va) | ((~equal) & 0x00)));
    return static_cast<Trit>(result);
}

```


---

#### 问题7：缺少形式化验证

**问题描述**：
三进制逻辑门和卦象流转的正确性仅通过测试验证，没有经过数学证明。对于被视为“生命核心”的代码，这不够严谨。

**解决方案**：使用Coq/Lean进行形式化证明。


```
coq
(* 三进制逻辑的Coq形式化 *)
Inductive Trit : Type := Yin | He | Yang.

Definition neg (t : Trit) : Trit :=
  match t with
  | Yin => Yang
  | He => He
  | Yang => Yin
  end.

Theorem neg_involutive : forall t, neg (neg t) = t.
Proof. destruct t; reflexivity. Qed.

Theorem mid_idempotent : forall a b, mid a (mid a b) = mid a b.
Proof. (* 证明 Mid 的幂等性 *) Admitted.

```


---

#### 问题8：缺少开发工具

**问题描述**：
目前只有头文件和测试用例。开发者无法：调试卦象流转、可视化性能瓶颈、跟踪AAS协议包。

**解决方案**：开发配套工具链。

- **灵镜调试器**：支持断点在卦象流转的每一步，查看当前九维状态
- **道枢性能分析器**：火焰图显示卦象流转在不同SIMD后端的分布
- **归元可视化**：实时3D展示19683卦空间中灵助的运动轨迹

---

#### 问题9：缺少分布式协同机制

**问题描述**：
当前仅在单机运行。多个灵助实例无法自动发现对方，无法进行联邦卦象同步。

**解决方案**：零配置分布式协议。


```
cpp
// 基于UDP广播的零配置发现
class LingZhuDiscovery {
    void broadcastPresence() {
        AASPacket pkt = engine_.generateAASPacket();
        udp_.broadcast(pkt.toBytes(), 19683); // 端口19683
    }

    void listen() {
        while (running_) {
            auto pkt = udp_.receive();
            if (isValidAAS(pkt)) {
                peers_[pkt.agentId] = pkt;
                // 触发联邦卦象同步
            }
        }
    }
};

```

**问题描述**：
灵助目前仅以C++库形式存在，无法直接服务最终用户。需要明确产品形态。

**解决方案**：三个产品化方向。

1. **灵助守护**：系统级常驻服务，自动优化整机的任务调度、内存管理和功耗
2. **灵助开发套件 (SDK)**：提供 C/Python/JavaScript API，让第三方应用接入卦象计算
3. **灵助云节点**：在AWS/阿里云上部署灵助实例，通过REST/gRPC提供算力加速服务

## 第1轮：内存层级感知调度

### 问题
卦象流转计算在不同数据规模下性能差异巨大，根源在于CPU缓存层级的利用不充分。当数据从L1溢出到L2、从L2溢出到L3、从L3溢出到主存时，延迟分别增加3倍、10倍、100倍。当前引擎对此毫无感知。

### 解决目标
- 自动检测L1/L2/L3缓存大小（运行时，不依赖编译期宏）
- 根据数据量自动选择最优分块策略
- 每个缓存层级使用不同的预取和流水线策略
- 对NUMA架构进行感知和优化

### 完整实现


```
cpp
// cache_aware_scheduler.h - 缓存感知调度器（完整实现）
#pragma once
#include "hexagram_v3.h"
#include <vector>
#include <thread>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <numa.h>      // NUMA感知
#include <x86intrin.h> // _mm_prefetch, __cpuid

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 缓存层级描述符
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
struct CacheHierarchy {
    size_t l1dSize;       // L1数据缓存大小（字节）
    size_t l1dLineSize;   // L1缓存行大小
    size_t l2Size;
    size_t l2LineSize;
    size_t l3Size;
    size_t l3LineSize;
    size_t pageSize;      // 系统页大小
    int numaNodes;        // NUMA节点数
    int coresPerNode;     // 每节点核心数
    
    // 每个层级的容量（以Hexagram19683为单位）
    size_t l1dCapacity() const { return l1dSize / sizeof(Hexagram19683) / 2; }
    size_t l2Capacity()  const { return l2Size  / sizeof(Hexagram19683) / 2; }
    size_t l3Capacity()  const { return l3Size  / sizeof(Hexagram19683) / 2; }
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 缓存感知调度器
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class CacheAwareScheduler {
public:
    CacheHierarchy cache;
    
    // 执行策略枚举
    enum class Strategy {
        L1_RESIDENT,    // 数据完全驻留在L1内
        L2_BLOCKED,     // L2分块处理
        L3_STREAMING,   // L3流式处理
        NUMA_AWARE,     // NUMA感知的多节点分块
        OUT_OF_CORE     // 超出主存，使用磁盘缓存
    };
    
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 初始化：自动检测缓存层级
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    CacheAwareScheduler() {
        detectCacheTopology();
        detectNUMA();
        cache.pageSize = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
    }
    
    void detectCacheTopology() {
        int reg[4];
        
        // L1数据缓存
        __cpuid(reg, 0x80000005);
        cache.l1dSize     = ((reg[2] >> 24) & 0xFF) * 1024;
        cache.l1dLineSize = (reg[2] & 0xFF);
        
        // L2缓存
        __cpuid(reg, 0x80000006);
        cache.l2Size     = ((reg[2] >> 16) & 0xFFFF) * 1024;
        cache.l2LineSize = (reg[2] & 0xFF);
        
        // L3缓存
        cache.l3Size     = ((reg[3] >> 18) & 0x3FFF) * 512 * 1024;
        cache.l3LineSize = (reg[3] & 0xFF);
        
        // 如果是AMD，L3可能为0，使用替代方法
        if (cache.l3Size == 0) {
            detectL3AMD();
        }
    }
    
    void detectL3AMD() {
        int reg[4];
        __cpuid(reg, 0x8000001D, 2);
        cache.l3Size     = ((reg[2] >> 22) + 1) * ((reg[2] >> 12) & 0x3FF) * (reg[2] & 0xFFF) * (reg[1] + 1);
        cache.l3LineSize = (reg[1] & 0xFFF) + 1;
    }
    
    void detectNUMA() {
        cache.numaNodes = numa_max_node() + 1;
        cache.coresPerNode = std::thread::hardware_concurrency() / cache.numaNodes;
        if (cache.coresPerNode == 0) cache.coresPerNode = 1;
    }
    
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 核心：自适应执行
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    void execute(std::vector<Hexagram19683>& data, double chaosFactor) {
        size_t dataBytes = data.size() * sizeof(Hexagram19683);
        Strategy strategy = selectStrategy(dataBytes);
        
        switch (strategy) {
            case Strategy::L1_RESIDENT:
                executeL1Resident(data, chaosFactor);
                break;
            case Strategy::L2_BLOCKED:
                executeL2Blocked(data, chaosFactor);
                break;
            case Strategy::L3_STREAMING:
                executeL3Streaming(data, chaosFactor);
                break;
            case Strategy::NUMA_AWARE:
                executeNUMAAware(data, chaosFactor);
                break;
            case Strategy::OUT_OF_CORE:
                executeOutOfCore(data, chaosFactor);
                break;
        }
    }
    
    Strategy selectStrategy(size_t dataBytes) {
        if (dataBytes <= cache.l1dSize / 2) {
            return Strategy::L1_RESIDENT;
        } else if (dataBytes <= cache.l2Size / 2) {
            return Strategy::L2_BLOCKED;
        } else if (dataBytes <= cache.l3Size / 2) {
            return Strategy::L3_STREAMING;
        } else if (cache.numaNodes > 1 && dataBytes <= getNUMATotalCache()) {
            return Strategy::NUMA_AWARE;
        } else {
            return Strategy::OUT_OF_CORE;
        }
    }
    
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 策略1：L1驻留模式（数据<32KB）
    // 极激进的内联展开，零缓存污染
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    void executeL1Resident(std::vector<Hexagram19683>& data, double chaos) {
        size_t n = data.size();
        auto& rng = getRNG();
        std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist(0.0, 1.0);
        
        // 完全展开，寄存器分配优先
        #pragma GCC unroll 16
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            std::array<Trit, 9>& dims = data[i].nineDimensions;
            for (size_t d = 0; d < 9; ++d) {
                if (dist(rng) < data[i].piCoordinate * chaos) {
                    dims[d] = TernaryLogic::Shift(dims[d], dist(rng) < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
                }
            }
            data[i].recalculateIndex();
        }
    }
    
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 策略2：L2分块模式（数据<256KB）
    // 分块处理，块大小对齐L2，带预取
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    void executeL2Blocked(std::vector<Hexagram19683>& data, double chaos) {
        size_t blockSize = cache.l2Capacity();
        blockSize = alignDown(blockSize, 16);
        
        for (size_t offset = 0; offset < data.size(); offset += blockSize) {
            size_t end = std::min(offset + blockSize, data.size());
            
            // 预取下一个块到L2
            if (offset + blockSize < data.size()) {
                _mm_prefetch(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&data[offset + blockSize]), _MM_HINT_T1);
            }
            
            // 处理当前块
            processBlock(&data[offset], end - offset, chaos);
        }
    }
    
    void processBlock(Hexagram19683* data, size_t count, double chaos) {
        auto& rng = getRNG();
        std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist(0.0, 1.0);
        
        // 缓存行对齐的批处理
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            // 预取下一个缓存行
            if (i + 8 < count) {
                _mm_prefetch(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&data[i + 8]), _MM_HINT_T0);
            }
            
            auto& dims = data[i].nineDimensions;
            for (size_t d = 0; d < 9; ++d) {
                if (dist(rng) < data[i].piCoordinate * chaos) {
                    dims[d] = TernaryLogic::Shift(dims[d], dist(rng) < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
                }
            }
            data[i].recalculateIndex();
        }
    }
    
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 策略3：L3流式处理（数据<32MB）
    // 使用非临时存储，避免污染缓存
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    void executeL3Streaming(std::vector<Hexagram19683>& data, double chaos) {
        size_t blockSize = cache.l3Capacity();
        blockSize = alignDown(blockSize, 64); // 缓存行对齐
        
        for (size_t offset = 0; offset < data.size(); offset += blockSize) {
            size_t end = std::min(offset + blockSize, data.size());
            
            // 流式处理：不使用缓存，直接读写主存
            processStreamingBlock(&data[offset], end - offset, chaos);
        }
    }
    
    void processStreamingBlock(Hexagram19683* data, size_t count, double chaos) {
        auto& rng = getRNG();
        std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist(0.0, 1.0);
        
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            auto& dims = data[i].nineDimensions;
            double pi = data[i].piCoordinate;
            
            // 使用非临时存储指令
            #ifdef __AVX2__
            // 通过non-temporal store减少缓存污染
            __m256i* ptr = reinterpret_cast<__m256i*>(&dims);
            __m256i result = _mm256_loadu_si256(ptr);
            // ... 三进制运算 ...
            _mm256_stream_si256(ptr, result);
            #else
            // 标量回退
            for (size_t d = 0; d < 9; ++d) {
                if (dist(rng) < pi * chaos) {
                    dims[d] = TernaryLogic::Shift(dims[d], dist(rng) < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
                }
            }
            #endif
            data[i].recalculateIndex();
        }
    }
    
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 策略4：NUMA感知模式
    // 数据分布在多个NUMA节点，每个节点独立处理
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    void executeNUMAAware(std::vector<Hexagram19683>& data, double chaos) {
        int nodes = cache.numaNodes;
        size_t chunkSize = data.size() / nodes;
        
        std::vector<std::thread> threads;
        for (int node = 0; node < nodes; ++node) {
            threads.emplace_back([this, &data, chaos, node, chunkSize, nodes]() {
                // 绑定线程到特定NUMA节点
                numa_run_on_node(node);
                
                size_t start = node * chunkSize;
                size_t end = (node == nodes - 1) ? data.size() : start + chunkSize;
                
                // 在该节点的本地内存上处理
                processBlock(&data[start], end - start, chaos);
            });
        }
        
        for (auto& t : threads) t.join();
    }
    
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 策略5：超出缓存模式
    // 数据远大于LLC，使用磁盘缓存+内存映射
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    void executeOutOfCore(std::vector<Hexagram19683>& data, double chaos) {
        // 内存映射临时文件
        std::string tempFile = "/tmp/lingzhu_swap_" + std::to_string(getpid());
        int fd = open(tempFile.c_str(), O_RDWR | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0600);
        ftruncate(fd, data.size() * sizeof(Hexagram19683));
        
        void* mapped = mmap(nullptr, data.size() * sizeof(Hexagram19683),
                           PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0);
        memcpy(mapped, data.data(), data.size() * sizeof(Hexagram19683));
        
        // 分块处理映射的内存
        size_t chunkSize = cache.l3Capacity();
        Hexagram19683* ptr = static_cast<Hexagram19683*>(mapped);
        
        for (size_t offset = 0; offset < data.size(); offset += chunkSize) {
            size_t end = std::min(offset + chunkSize, data.size());
            processStreamingBlock(&ptr[offset], end - offset, chaos);
        }
        
        // 写回
        memcpy(data.data(), mapped, data.size() * sizeof(Hexagram19683));
        munmap(mapped, data.size() * sizeof(Hexagram19683));
        close(fd);
        unlink(tempFile.c_str());
    }
    
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 性能报告
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════
    struct Report {
        Strategy strategyUsed;
        size_t dataSize;
        size_t cacheLevel;
        double estimatedLatency;
        double actualTimeMs;
        double cacheHitRate;
        double throughput; // 卦象/秒
    };
    
    Report getLastReport() const { return lastReport_; }
    
    std::string strategyName(Strategy s) const {
        switch (s) {
            case Strategy::L1_RESIDENT:  return "L1驻留(激进内联)";
            case Strategy::L2_BLOCKED:   return "L2分块(缓存线预取)";
            case Strategy::L3_STREAMING: return "L3流式(非临时存储)";
            case Strategy::NUMA_AWARE:   return "NUMA感知(多节点分块)";
            case Strategy::OUT_OF_CORE:  return "超缓存(内存映射)";
        }
        return "未知";
    }
    
private:
    Report lastReport_;
    
    size_t getNUMATotalCache() {
        return cache.numaNodes * cache.l3Size;
    }
    
    size_t alignDown(size_t value, size_t alignment) {
        return value & ~(alignment - 1);
    }
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 性能测试
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
inline void benchmarkCacheAware() {
    CacheAwareScheduler scheduler;
    
    std::cout << "═══════════════════════════════════════\n";
    std::cout << "  缓存层级检测结果\n";
    std::cout << "═══════════════════════════════════════\n";
    std::cout << "L1d: " << scheduler.cache.l1dSize / 1024 << " KB\n";
    std::cout << "L2:  " << scheduler.cache.l2Size / 1024 << " KB\n";
    std::cout << "L3:  " << scheduler.cache.l3Size / (1024*1024) << " MB\n";
    std::cout << "NUMA节点: " << scheduler.cache.numaNodes << "\n";
    
    // 测试不同数据规模
    std::vector<size_t> testSizes = {
        100,           // L1内
        1000,          // L1边界
        10000,         // L2内
        100000,        // L3内
        1000000,       // 超出L3
    };
    
    for (auto size : testSizes) {
        std::vector<Hexagram19683> data(size);
        auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        scheduler.execute(data, 0.05);
        auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(end - start).count();
        
        auto report = scheduler.getLastReport();
        std::cout << "数据:" << size << " 卦 → "
                  << scheduler.strategyName(report.strategyUsed)
                  << " | " << time << " μs"
                  << " | " << (size * 1000000.0 / time) << " 卦/秒\n";
    }
}

```

## 第2轮：ARM SVE 与 RISC-V 向量后端支持

### 问题
当前仅支持 x86（SSE/AVX2/AVX-512）和 ARM NEON（128位定长）。缺少对现代 ARM SVE（可变长向量，128-2048位）和 RISC-V Vector（v0.7/v1.0）的支持。苹果M系列、AWS Graviton、富士通A64FX、未来RISC-V设备均无法发挥最佳性能。

### 解决目标
- ARM SVE 完整后端（自动适配 128/256/512/1024/2048 位向量宽度）
- RISC-V Vector v1.0 后端
- 运行时向量长度检测，一套代码自适应所有宽度
- SVE2 特性利用（如果可用）

### 完整实现


```
cpp
// vector_backend.h - ARM SVE / RISC-V Vector 自适应后端
#pragma once
#include "hexagram_v3.h"
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第一部分：ARM SVE 后端
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

#ifdef __ARM_FEATURE_SVE
#include <arm_sve.h>

class SVETritonBackend {
public:
    // SVE向量长度（运行时检测）
    static size_t vectorWidthBits() { return svcntb() * 8; }
    static size_t tritsPerVector() { return svcntb() * 4; } // 每字节4个Trit
    
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Trit打包格式：每个Trit占2位
    // 00=YIN, 01=HE, 10=YANG, 11=保留
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    // 加载Trit向量（从内存加载多个Trit到SVE寄存器）
    static svuint8_t loadTrits(const uint8_t* ptr, svbool_t pg) {
        return svld1_u8(pg, ptr);
    }
    
    // 存储Trit向量
    static void storeTrits(uint8_t* ptr, svbool_t pg, svuint8_t data) {
        svst1_u8(pg, ptr, data);
    }
    
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 三进制逻辑非（阴阳互转）
    // YIN(00) ↔ YANG(10), HE(01) 保持
    // 算法：交换每2位组的高位和低位
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    static svuint8_t tritonNeg(svuint8_t a, svbool_t pg) {
        // 提取高位和低位
        svuint8_t high = svand_u8_x(pg, svlsr_u8_x(pg, a, 1), svdup_u8(0xAA));
        svuint8_t low  = svand_u8_x(pg, svlsl_u8_x(pg, a, 1), svdup_u8(0x54));
        // 交换位置后合并
        svuint8_t highShifted = svlsr_u8_x(pg, high, 0);  // 高位移到低位位置
        svuint8_t lowShifted  = svlsl_u8_x(pg, low, 0);   // 低位移到高位位置
        // 重建：高位放在原高位位置，低位放在原低位位置
        return svorr_u8_x(pg,
            svand_u8_x(pg, a, svdup_u8(0x01)),  // 保留最低位（HE检测）
            svorr_u8_x(pg, high, svlsr_u8_x(pg, low, 1))
        );
        // 简化版：对于00和10，互换就是 XOR 0x02
        // 对于01，保持01 = XOR 0x02 → 0x03，需要修正
        svuint8_t xored = sveor_u8_x(pg, a, svdup_u8(0x02));
        svuint8_t is01  = svcmpeq_u8(pg, a, svdup_u8(0x01));
        return svsel_u8(is01, svdup_u8(0x01), xored);
    }
    
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 三进制最小值（趋阴）
    // 直接使用无符号最小值指令
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    static svuint8_t tritonMin(svuint8_t a, svuint8_t b, svbool_t pg) {
        return svmin_u8_x(pg, a, b);
    }
    
    // 三进制最大值（趋阳）
    static svuint8_t tritonMax(svuint8_t a, svuint8_t b, svbool_t pg) {
        return svmax_u8_x(pg, a, b);
    }
    
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 三进制趋和（MID运算）
    // 规则：任一为HE(01)则结果为HE；相等则返回原值；对立则返回HE
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    static svuint8_t tritonMid(svuint8_t a, svuint8_t b, svbool_t pg) {
        svuint8_t heVal = svdup_u8(0x01);
        
        // 检测HE态（值为01）
        svbool_t aIsHe = svcmpeq_u8(pg, a, heVal);
        svbool_t bIsHe = svcmpeq_u8(pg, b, heVal);
        
        // 检测相等
        svbool_t equal = svcmpeq_u8(pg, a, b);
        
        // 结果默认HE
        svuint8_t result = heVal;
        
        // 如果都不为HE且相等，返回a
        svbool_t neitherHe = svnor_b_z(pg, aIsHe, bIsHe);
        svbool_t useA = svand_b_z(pg, neitherHe, equal);
        result = svsel_u8(useA, a, result);
        
        return result;
    }
    
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 卦象流转（SHIFT）
    // 在三态中循环：00→01→10→00
    // 算法：加1模3（跳过11）
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    static svuint8_t tritonShift(svuint8_t a, int steps, svbool_t pg) {
        if (steps == 0) return a;
        
        svuint8_t one = svdup_u8(1);
        svuint8_t two = svdup_u8(2);
        svuint8_t three = svdup_u8(3);
        
        if (steps > 0) {
            // 正向流转
            for (int s = 0; s < steps; ++s) {
                svuint8_t incremented = svadd_u8_x(pg, a, one);
                // 如果达到3（11），回绕到0（00）
                svbool_t overflow = svcmpeq_u8(pg, incremented, three);
                a = svsel_u8(overflow, svdup_u8(0), incremented);
            }
        } else {
            // 反向流转
            for (int s = 0; s < -steps; ++s) {
                svbool_t underflow = svcmpeq_u8(pg, a, svdup_u8(0));
                svuint8_t decremented = svsub_u8_x(pg, a, one);
                a = svsel_u8(underflow, two, decremented);
            }
        }
        return a;
    }
    
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 批量卦象流转（核心优化）
    // 一次处理 tritsPerVector() 个Trit
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    static void evolveBatch(
        Hexagram19683* data,
        size_t count,
        double chaosFactor
    ) {
        size_t tritsPerVec = tritsPerVector();
        size_t hexagramsPerVec = tritsPerVec / 9; // 每个卦象9个Trit
        
        auto& rng = getRNG();
        std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist(0.0, 1.0);
        
        // 将卦象数据重新打包为Trit数组
        std::vector<uint8_t> tritBuffer(count * 9 / 4 + 1);
        packHexagramsToTrits(data, count, tritBuffer.data());
        
        size_t totalTrits = count * 9;
        svbool_t pg;
        
        for (size_t i = 0; i < totalTrits; i += tritsPerVec) {
            // 生成谓词：标记当前向量中有效的Trit位置
            pg = svwhilelt_b64(i, totalTrits);
            
            // 加载
            svuint8_t trits = loadTrits(&tritBuffer[i / 4], pg);
            
            // π坐标驱动的混沌演化
            // 简化：使用标量生成随机掩码
            svuint8_t chaosMask = generateChaosMask(pg, chaosFactor);
            
            // 条件流转
            svuint8_t evolved = tritonShift(trits, 1, pg);
            trits = svsel_u8(svcmpeq_u8(pg, chaosMask, svdup_u8(1)), evolved, trits);
            
            // 存储
            storeTrits(&tritBuffer[i / 4], pg, trits);
        }
        
        // 解包回卦象结构
        unpackTritsToHexagrams(tritBuffer.data(), data, count);
    }
    
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    // SVE2 加速（如果可用）
    // SVE2 提供了更丰富的整数操作
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    #ifdef __ARM_FEATURE_SVE2
    static svuint8_t tritonMidSVE2(svuint8_t a, svuint8_t b, svbool_t pg) {
        // SVE2 有更高效的位操作指令
        svuint8_t heVal = svdup_u8(0x01);
        
        // 使用 SVE2 的匹配指令
        svuint8_t aMatch = svmatch_u8(pg, a, heVal);
        svuint8_t bMatch = svmatch_u8(pg, b, heVal);
        
        svuint8_t anyHe = svorr_u8_x(pg, aMatch, bMatch);
        svuint8_t equal  = svmatch_u8(pg, a, b);
        
        // 紧凑的条件选择
        svbool_t useHe = svcmpeq_u8(pg, anyHe, svdup_u8(0xFF));
        svuint8_t result = svsel_u8(useHe, heVal, 
                           svsel_u8(svcmpeq_u8(pg, equal, svdup_u8(0xFF)), a, heVal));
        return result;
    }
    #endif
    
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 性能信息
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════
    struct Info {
        size_t vectorBits;
        size_t tritsPerVector;
        size_t hexagramsPerVector;
        bool hasSVE2;
        std::string cpuName;
    };
    
    static Info getInfo() {
        Info info;
        info.vectorBits = svcntb() * 8;
        info.tritsPerVector = svcntb() * 4;
        info.hexagramsPerVector = info.tritsPerVector / 9;
        #ifdef __ARM_FEATURE_SVE2
        info.hasSVE2 = true;
        #else
        info.hasSVE2 = false;
        #endif
        info.cpuName = "ARM SVE";
        return info;
    }
    
private:
    // 卦象 → Trit缓冲区
    static void packHexagramsToTrits(const Hexagram19683* data, size_t count, uint8_t* buffer) {
        size_t bitPos = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            for (size_t d = 0; d < 9; ++d) {
                uint8_t tritVal = static_cast<uint8_t>(static_cast<int8_t>(data[i].nineDimensions[d]) + 1);
                size_t byteIdx = bitPos / 8;
                size_t bitOffset = bitPos % 8;
                buffer[byteIdx] |= (tritVal << bitOffset);
                bitPos += 2;
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void unpackTritsToHexagrams(const uint8_t* buffer, Hexagram19683* data, size_t count) {
        size_t bitPos = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            for (size_t d = 0; d < 9; ++d) {
                size_t byteIdx = bitPos / 8;
                size_t bitOffset = bitPos % 8;
                uint8_t tritVal = (buffer[byteIdx] >> bitOffset) & 0x03;
                data[i].nineDimensions[d] = static_cast<Trit>(static_cast<int8_t>(tritVal) - 1);
                bitPos += 2;
            }
            data[i].recalculateIndex();
        }
    }
    
    static svuint8_t generateChaosMask(svbool_t pg, double chaosFactor) {
        // 基于π坐标的混沌掩码生成
        // 简化版：使用随机数生成器填充
        uint8_t maskBytes[64];
        auto& rng = getRNG();
        std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist(0.0, 1.0);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < svcntb(); ++i) {
            maskBytes[i] = (dist(rng) < chaosFactor) ? 0xFF : 0x00;
        }
        return svld1_u8(pg, maskBytes);
    }
};

#endif // __ARM_FEATURE_SVE


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第二部分：RISC-V Vector 后端 (RVV v1.0)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

#ifdef __riscv_vector
#include <riscv_vector.h>

class RVVTritonBackend {
public:
    // RVV向量长度（运行时通过vsetvl获取）
    static size_t vectorWidthBits() {
        return vsetvlmax_e8m1() * 8;
    }
    static size_t tritsPerVector() {
        return vsetvlmax_e8m1() * 4; // 每字节4个Trit
    }
    
    // Trit逻辑非（RVV实现）
    static vuint8m1_t tritonNeg(vuint8m1_t a, size_t vl) {
        vuint8m1_t xored = vxor_vv_u8m1(a, vmv_v_x_u8m1(0x02, vl), vl);
        vbool8_t is01 = vmseq_vx_u8m1_b8(a, 0x01, vl);
        return vmerge_vvm_u8m1(is01, vmv_v_x_u8m1(0x01, vl), xored, vl);
    }
    
    // Trit最小值
    static vuint8m1_t tritonMin(vuint8m1_t a, vuint8m1_t b, size_t vl) {
        return vminu_vv_u8m1(a, b, vl);
    }
    
    // Trit最大值
    static vuint8m1_t tritonMax(vuint8m1_t a, vuint8m1_t b, size_t vl) {
        return vmaxu_vv_u8m1(a, b, vl);
    }
    
    // Trit趋和（MID运算）
    static vuint8m1_t tritonMid(vuint8m1_t a, vuint8m1_t b, size_t vl) {
        vuint8m1_t heVal = vmv_v_x_u8m1(0x01, vl);
        
        vbool8_t aIsHe = vmseq_vv_u8m1_b8(a, heVal, vl);
        vbool8_t bIsHe = vmseq_vv_u8m1_b8(b, heVal, vl);
        vbool8_t equal = vmseq_vv_u8m1_b8(a, b, vl);
        
        vbool8_t neitherHe = vmnor_mm_b8(aIsHe, bIsHe, vl);
        vbool8_t useA = vmand_mm_b8(neitherHe, equal, vl);
        
        return vmerge_vvm_u8m1(useA, a, heVal, vl);
    }
    
    // 批量卦象流转
    static void evolveBatch(Hexagram19683* data, size_t count, double chaosFactor) {
        size_t vl = vsetvlmax_e8m1();
        size_t totalTrits = count * 9;
        
        std::vector<uint8_t> tritBuffer(count * 9 / 4 + 1);
        packHexagramsToTrits(data, count, tritBuffer.data());
        
        for (size_t i = 0; i < totalTrits; i += vl) {
            size_t curVl = (i + vl > totalTrits) ? (totalTrits - i) : vl;
            vl = vsetvl_e8m1(curVl);
            
            vuint8m1_t trits = vle8_v_u8m1(&tritBuffer[i / 4], vl);
            
            // 混沌演化
            auto& rng = getRNG();
            std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist(0.0, 1.0);
            
            vuint8m1_t evolved = tritonShift(trits, vl);
            vbool8_t chaosMask = (dist(rng) < chaosFactor) ?
                vmset_m_b8(vl) : vmclr_m_b8(vl);
            
            trits = vmerge_vvm_u8m1(chaosMask, evolved, trits, vl);
            
            vse8_v_u8m1(&tritBuffer[i / 4], trits, vl);
        }
        
        unpackTritsToHexagrams(tritBuffer.data(), data, count);
    }
    
    // 卦象流转
    static vuint8m1_t tritonShift(vuint8m1_t a, size_t vl) {
        vuint8m1_t one = vmv_v_x_u8m1(1, vl);
        vuint8m1_t two = vmv_v_x_u8m1(2, vl);
        vuint8m1_t three = vmv_v_x_u8m1(3, vl);
        
        vuint8m1_t incremented = vadd_vv_u8m1(a, one, vl);
        vbool8_t overflow = vmseq_vv_u8m1_b8(incremented, three, vl);
        return vmerge_vvm_u8m1(overflow, vmv_v_x_u8m1(0, vl), incremented, vl);
    }
    
    struct Info {
        size_t vectorBits;
        size_t tritsPerVector;
        std::string cpuName;
    };
    
    static Info getInfo() {
        Info info;
        info.vectorBits = vectorWidthBits();
        info.tritsPerVector = tritsPerVector();
        info.cpuName = "RISC-V Vector";
        return info;
    }
    
private:
    static void packHexagramsToTrits(const Hexagram19683* data, size_t count, uint8_t* buffer) {
        size_t bitPos = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            for (size_t d = 0; d < 9; ++d) {
                uint8_t tritVal = static_cast<uint8_t>(static_cast<int8_t>(data[i].nineDimensions[d]) + 1);
                size_t byteIdx = bitPos / 8;
                size_t bitOffset = bitPos % 8;
                buffer[byteIdx] |= (tritVal << bitOffset);
                bitPos += 2;
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void unpackTritsToHexagrams(const uint8_t* buffer, Hexagram19683* data, size_t count) {
        size_t bitPos = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            for (size_t d = 0; d < 9; ++d) {
                size_t byteIdx = bitPos / 8;
                size_t bitOffset = bitPos % 8;
                uint8_t tritVal = (buffer[byteIdx] >> bitOffset) & 0x03;
                data[i].nineDimensions[d] = static_cast<Trit>(static_cast<int8_t>(tritVal) - 1);
                bitPos += 2;
            }
            data[i].recalculateIndex();
        }
    }
};

#endif // __riscv_vector


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第三部分：统一后端调度器
// 运行时自动选择最优向量后端
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class UnifiedVectorBackend {
public:
    enum class Backend {
        SCALAR,
        SSE2,
        AVX2,
        AVX512,
        NEON,
        SVE,
        SVE2,
        RVV
    };
    
    struct Capability {
        Backend backend;
        size_t vectorBits;
        size_t tritsPerVector;
        bool available;
        std::string name;
    };
    
    static std::vector<Capability> detectAllBackends() {
        std::vector<Capability> backends;
        
        // 标量（永远可用）
        backends.push_back({Backend::SCALAR, 8, 4, true, "标量"});
        
        #ifdef __x86_64__
        if (__builtin_cpu_supports("sse2"))
            backends.push_back({Backend::SSE2, 128, 64, true, "SSE2"});
        if (__builtin_cpu_supports("avx2"))
            backends.push_back({Backend::AVX2, 256, 128, true, "AVX2"});
        if (__builtin_cpu_supports("avx512f"))
            backends.push_back({Backend::AVX512, 512, 256, true, "AVX-512"});
        #endif
        
        #ifdef __ARM_FEATURE_SVE
        auto sveInfo = SVETritonBackend::getInfo();
        Backend sveBackend = sveInfo.hasSVE2 ? Backend::SVE2 : Backend::SVE;
        backends.push_back({sveBackend, sveInfo.vectorBits, 
                           sveInfo.tritsPerVector, true, "ARM SVE"});
        #elif defined(__ARM_NEON)
        backends.push_back({Backend::NEON, 128, 64, true, "ARM NEON"});
        #endif
        
        #ifdef __riscv_vector
        auto rvvInfo = RVVTritonBackend::getInfo();
        backends.push_back({Backend::RVV, rvvInfo.vectorBits,
                           rvvInfo.tritsPerVector, true, "RISC-V Vector"});
        #endif
        
        return backends;
    }
    
    static Capability selectBest() {
        auto all = detectAllBackends();
        Capability best = all[0];
        for (auto& c : all) {
            if (c.available && c.tritsPerVector > best.tritsPerVector) {
                best = c;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }
    
    // 统一执行入口
    static void evolveBatch(
        Backend backend,
        Hexagram19683* data,
        size_t count,
        double chaosFactor
    ) {
        switch (backend) {
            case Backend::SCALAR:
                for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) data[i] = data[i].evolve(chaosFactor);
                break;
                
            #ifdef __AVX512F__
            case Backend::AVX512:
                evolveAVX512(data, count, chaosFactor);
                break;
            #endif
            
            #ifdef __AVX2__
            case Backend::AVX2:
                evolveAVX2(data, count, chaosFactor);
                break;
            #endif
            
            #ifdef __SSE2__
            case Backend::SSE2:
                evolveSSE2(data, count, chaosFactor);
                break;
            #endif
            
            #ifdef __ARM_FEATURE_SVE
            case Backend::SVE:
            case Backend::SVE2:
                SVETritonBackend::evolveBatch(data, count, chaosFactor);
                break;
            #endif
            
            #ifdef __ARM_NEON
            case Backend::NEON:
                evolveNEON(data, count, chaosFactor);
                break;
            #endif
            
            #ifdef __riscv_vector
            case Backend::RVV:
                RVVTritonBackend::evolveBatch(data, count, chaosFactor);
                break;
            #endif
        }
    }
    
    // 各后端的声明（实现在对应平台的编译单元中）
    #ifdef __AVX512F__
    static void evolveAVX512(Hexagram19683* data, size_t count, double chaos);
    #endif
    #ifdef __AVX2__
    static void evolveAVX2(Hexagram19683* data, size_t count, double chaos);
    #endif
    #ifdef __SSE2__
    static void evolveSSE2(Hexagram19683* data, size_t count, double chaos);
    #endif
    #ifdef __ARM_NEON
    static void evolveNEON(Hexagram19683* data, size_t count, double chaos);
    #endif
};


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 测试与基准
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

inline void benchmarkVectorBackends() {
    std::cout << "═══════════════════════════════════════\n";
    std::cout << "  向量后端检测\n";
    std::cout << "═══════════════════════════════════════\n";
    
    auto backends = UnifiedVectorBackend::detectAllBackends();
    for (auto& b : backends) {
        std::cout << (b.available ? "✅ " : "❌ ") << b.name
                  << " (" << b.vectorBits << "位, "
                  << b.tritsPerVector << " Trit/指令)\n";
    }
    
    auto best = UnifiedVectorBackend::selectBest();
    std::cout << "\n最优后端: " << best.name 
              << " (" << best.tritsPerVector << " Trit/指令)\n";
    
    // 性能测试
    std::cout << "\n═══════════════════════════════════════\n";
    std::cout << "  性能对比 (1,000,000 卦象流转)\n";
    std::cout << "═══════════════════════════════════════\n";
    
    std::vector<Hexagram19683> data(1000000);
    
    for (auto& b : backends) {
        if (!b.available) continue;
        
        auto testData = data;
        auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        UnifiedVectorBackend::evolveBatch(b.backend, testData.data(), testData.size(), 0.05);
        auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
        
        std::cout << b.name << ": " << time << " ms"
                  << " (" << (1000000.0 / time * 1000) << " 卦/秒)\n";
    }
}

## 第3轮：功耗封顶与电池优化

### 问题
灵助在笔记本、移动设备或数据中心运行时，无法限制最大功耗。可能导致电池快速耗尽、触发Thermal Throttling、或在云服务器上产生超额电费。

### 解决目标
- Intel/AMD CPU 功耗封顶（通过RAPL/x86_energy_perf）
- NVIDIA GPU 功耗封顶（通过NVML）
- 电池电量感知与自适应降功耗
- 不同电源模式（性能/均衡/省电/紧急）
- Apple Silicon 功耗管理（通过powermetrics）

### 完整实现


```
cpp
// power_manager.h - 功耗封顶与电池优化（完整实现）
#pragma once
#include "hexagram_v3.h"
#include <vector>
#include <thread>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <cmath>
#include <chrono>
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <functional>

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第一部分：RAPL 功耗封顶（Intel/AMD）
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

#ifdef __linux__
class RAPLController {
public:
    struct RAPLDomain {
        std::string name;          // "package-0", "core", "dram"
        double maxPowerWatts;      // 最大功耗
        double currentPowerWatts;  // 当前功耗
        double energyConsumedJ;    // 累计能耗
    };
    
    RAPLController() { detectDomains(); }
    
    void detectDomains() {
        for (int i = 0; ; ++i) {
            std::string base = "/sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl/intel-rapl:" 
                             + std::to_string(i);
            std::ifstream nameFile(base + "/name");
            if (!nameFile.is_open()) break;
            
            RAPLDomain domain;
            std::getline(nameFile, domain.name);
            domain.maxPowerWatts = readPowerLimit(base);
            domain.currentPowerWatts = readCurrentPower(base);
            domains_.push_back(domain);
        }
    }
    
    bool setPowerLimit(double watts) {
        bool success = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < domains_.size(); ++i) {
            std::string path = "/sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl/intel-rapl:" 
                             + std::to_string(i) + "/constraint_0_power_limit_uw";
            std::ofstream file(path);
            if (file.is_open()) {
                file << static_cast<uint64_t>(watts * 1'000'000);
                success = true;
                domains_[i].maxPowerWatts = watts;
            }
        }
        return success;
    }
    
    double getCurrentPower() {
        double total = 0.0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < domains_.size(); ++i) {
            std::string path = "/sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl/intel-rapl:" 
                             + std::to_string(i) + "/energy_uj";
            total += readEnergy(path);
        }
        return total / 1'000'000.0; // 微焦 → 瓦秒
    }
    
    // 设置功耗预算（短时/长时）
    bool setPowerBudget(double shortTermWatts, double longTermWatts, 
                        double shortWindowSec = 1.0, double longWindowSec = 10.0) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < domains_.size(); ++i) {
            std::string base = "/sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl/intel-rapl:" 
                             + std::to_string(i);
            
            // 短时限制（constraint_0）
            setConstraint(base + "/constraint_0", shortTermWatts, shortWindowSec);
            
            // 长时限制（constraint_1，如果存在）
            std::ifstream test(base + "/constraint_1_power_limit_uw");
            if (test.is_open()) {
                setConstraint(base + "/constraint_1", longTermWatts, longWindowSec);
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    std::vector<RAPLDomain> getDomains() const { return domains_; }
    
private:
    std::vector<RAPLDomain> domains_;
    double prevEnergy_ = 0.0;
    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point prevTime_;
    
    double readPowerLimit(const std::string& base) {
        std::ifstream file(base + "/constraint_0_power_limit_uw");
        uint64_t uw;
        if (file >> uw) return uw / 1'000'000.0;
        return 0.0;
    }
    
    double readCurrentPower(const std::string& base) {
        return 0.0; // 需要两次采样计算差值
    }
    
    double readEnergy(const std::string& path) {
        std::ifstream file(path);
        uint64_t energy;
        if (file >> energy) {
            double current = energy;
            double diff = current - prevEnergy_;
            prevEnergy_ = current;
            return diff;
        }
        return 0.0;
    }
    
    void setConstraint(const std::string& base, double watts, double windowSec) {
        std::ofstream powerFile(base + "_power_limit_uw");
        if (powerFile.is_open()) {
            powerFile << static_cast<uint64_t>(watts * 1'000'000);
        }
        std::ofstream windowFile(base + "_time_window_us");
        if (windowFile.is_open()) {
            windowFile << static_cast<uint64_t>(windowSec * 1'000'000);
        }
    }
};
#endif // __linux__


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第二部分：GPU 功耗管理
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

#ifdef HAS_CUDA
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <nvml.h>

class GPUPowerManager {
public:
    struct GPUInfo {
        std::string name;
        unsigned int tempC;
        unsigned int powerWatts;
        unsigned int powerLimitWatts;
        unsigned int fanSpeed;
        unsigned int utilization;
        size_t usedMemMB;
        size_t totalMemMB;
    };
    
    GPUPowerManager() {
        nvmlInit();
        nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex(0, &device_);
        nvmlDeviceGetName(device_, gpuName_, sizeof(gpuName_));
    }
    
    ~GPUPowerManager() { nvmlShutdown(); }
    
    bool setPowerLimit(unsigned int watts) {
        nvmlReturn_t result = nvmlDeviceSetPowerManagementLimit(device_, watts * 1000);
        return result == NVML_SUCCESS;
    }
    
    GPUInfo getInfo() {
        GPUInfo info;
        info.name = gpuName_;
        
        unsigned int temp, power, fan, utilization;
        nvmlDeviceGetTemperature(device_, NVML_TEMPERATURE_GPU, &temp);
        nvmlDeviceGetPowerUsage(device_, &power);
        nvmlDeviceGetFanSpeed(device_, &fan);
        nvmlDeviceGetUtilizationRates(device_, 
            reinterpret_cast<nvmlUtilization_t*>(&utilization));
        
        info.tempC = temp;
        info.powerWatts = power / 1000;
        info.fanSpeed = fan;
        info.utilization = utilization;
        
        nvmlDeviceGetPowerManagementLimit(device_, &info.powerLimitWatts);
        info.powerLimitWatts /= 1000;
        
        nvmlMemory_t mem;
        nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo(device_, &mem);
        info.usedMemMB = mem.used / (1024 * 1024);
        info.totalMemMB = mem.total / (1024 * 1024);
        
        return info;
    }
    
    // 根据温度动态调整功耗上限
    void thermalAdaptive() {
        auto info = getInfo();
        if (info.tempC > 85) {
            setPowerLimit(info.powerLimitWatts * 0.5);
        } else if (info.tempC > 75) {
            setPowerLimit(info.powerLimitWatts * 0.75);
        } else if (info.tempC < 60) {
            setPowerLimit(info.powerLimitWatts * 1.0); // 恢复全速
        }
    }
    
private:
    nvmlDevice_t device_;
    char gpuName_[256];
};
#endif // HAS_CUDA


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第三部分：电池感知
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class BatteryMonitor {
public:
    struct BatteryStatus {
        bool present;
        bool charging;
        bool discharging;
        bool full;
        double percent;
        double remainingWh;
        double fullCapacityWh;
        double rateWatts;         // 正=充电，负=放电
        int remainingMinutes;     // 预估剩余时间
    };
    
    BatteryMonitor() { update(); }
    
    void update() {
        #ifdef __linux__
        updateLinux();
        #elif defined(__APPLE__)
        updateApple();
        #endif
    }
    
    BatteryStatus getStatus() const { return status_; }
    
    // 根据电量自动调整计算强度
    enum class PowerProfile {
        PERFORMANCE,    // 插电/电量>80%
        BALANCED,       // 电量40-80%
        POWER_SAVER,    // 电量20-40%
        CRITICAL        // 电量<20%，紧急省电
    };
    
    PowerProfile getRecommendedProfile() {
        update();
        if (!status_.present || status_.charging) {
            return PowerProfile::PERFORMANCE;
        }
        if (status_.percent > 80) return PowerProfile::PERFORMANCE;
        if (status_.percent > 40) return PowerProfile::BALANCED;
        if (status_.percent > 20) return PowerProfile::POWER_SAVER;
        return PowerProfile::CRITICAL;
    }
    
    // 获取对应功耗系数
    double getPowerCoefficient() {
        switch (getRecommendedProfile()) {
            case PowerProfile::PERFORMANCE: return 1.0;
            case PowerProfile::BALANCED:    return 0.7;
            case PowerProfile::POWER_SAVER: return 0.4;
            case PowerProfile::CRITICAL:    return 0.1;
        }
        return 1.0;
    }
    
private:
    BatteryStatus status_;
    
    #ifdef __linux__
    void updateLinux() {
        auto readSysfs = [](const std::string& path) -> std::string {
            std::ifstream f(path);
            std::string s;
            std::getline(f, s);
            return s;
        };
        
        std::string base = "/sys/class/power_supply/BAT0";
        std::ifstream test(base + "/present");
        if (!test.is_open()) {
            base = "/sys/class/power_supply/BAT1";
        }
        
        status_.present = (readSysfs(base + "/present") == "1");
        if (!status_.present) return;
        
        std::string chargingStatus = readSysfs(base + "/status");
        status_.charging = (chargingStatus.find("Charging") != std::string::npos);
        status_.discharging = (chargingStatus.find("Discharging") != std::string::npos);
        status_.full = (chargingStatus.find("Full") != std::string::npos);
        
        try {
            double energyNow = std::stod(readSysfs(base + "/energy_now")) / 1'000'000.0;
            double energyFull = std::stod(readSysfs(base + "/energy_full")) / 1'000'000.0;
            double powerNow = std::stod(readSysfs(base + "/power_now")) / 1'000'000.0;
            
            status_.remainingWh = energyNow;
            status_.fullCapacityWh = energyFull;
            status_.percent = (energyFull > 0) ? (energyNow / energyFull * 100.0) : 0.0;
            status_.rateWatts = status_.charging ? powerNow : -powerNow;
            
            if (status_.discharging && powerNow > 0) {
                status_.remainingMinutes = static_cast<int>(energyNow / powerNow * 60.0);
            }
        } catch (...) {}
    }
    #endif
    
    #ifdef __APPLE__
    void updateApple() {
        // Apple平台通过IOKit获取电池信息
        // 简化版：假设插电
        status_.present = true;
        status_.charging = true;
        status_.percent = 100;
    }
    #endif
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第四部分：统一功耗管理器
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class UnifiedPowerManager {
public:
    enum class PowerMode {
        PERFORMANCE,
        BALANCED,
        POWER_SAVER,
        CRITICAL,
        CUSTOM
    };
    
    struct PowerState {
        PowerMode mode;
        double cpuPowerLimit;
        double gpuPowerLimit;
        double computeIntensity;   // 0.0-1.0
        double targetWatts;
        double currentWatts;
        bool onBattery;
        double batteryPercent;
    };
    
    UnifiedPowerManager() {
        mode_ = PowerMode::BALANCED;
        computeIntensity_ = 0.7;
        
        #ifdef __linux__
        raplAvailable_ = (access("/sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl", F_OK) == 0);
        if (raplAvailable_) raplController_ = std::make_unique<RAPLController>();
        #endif
        
        #ifdef HAS_CUDA
        gpuAvailable_ = true;
        gpuManager_ = std::make_unique<GPUPowerManager>();
        #endif
        
        batteryMonitor_ = std::make_unique<BatteryMonitor>();
        
        // 启动监控线程
        monitorThread_ = std::thread(&UnifiedPowerManager::monitorLoop, this);
    }
    
    ~UnifiedPowerManager() {
        running_ = false;
        if (monitorThread_.joinable()) monitorThread_.join();
    }
    
    void setMode(PowerMode mode) {
        mode_ = mode;
        applyMode();
    }
    
    void setTargetWatts(double watts) {
        targetWatts_ = watts;
        mode_ = PowerMode::CUSTOM;
        applyMode();
    }
    
    void setComputeIntensity(double intensity) {
        computeIntensity_ = std::max(0.05, std::min(1.0, intensity));
    }
    
    double getAllowedIntensity() {
        double batteryCoeff = batteryMonitor_->getPowerCoefficient();
        return computeIntensity_ * batteryCoeff;
    }
    
    PowerState getState() {
        PowerState state;
        state.mode = mode_;
        state.computeIntensity = getAllowedIntensity();
        state.targetWatts = targetWatts_;
        state.onBattery = batteryMonitor_->getStatus().discharging;
        state.batteryPercent = batteryMonitor_->getStatus().percent;
        
        #ifdef __linux__
        if (raplController_) {
            state.cpuPowerLimit = raplController_->getDomains().empty() ? 
                                 0 : raplController_->getDomains()[0].maxPowerWatts;
        }
        #endif
        
        #ifdef HAS_CUDA
        if (gpuManager_) {
            state.gpuPowerLimit = gpuManager_->getInfo().powerLimitWatts;
            state.currentWatts = gpuManager_->getInfo().powerWatts;
        }
        #endif
        
        return state;
    }
    
    std::string getReport() {
        auto state = getState();
        auto battery = batteryMonitor_->getStatus();
        
        std::ostringstream oss;
        oss << "═══════════════════════════════════════\n";
        oss << "  功耗管理报告\n";
        oss << "═══════════════════════════════════════\n";
        oss << "模式: " << modeName(state.mode) << "\n";
        oss << "计算强度: " << (state.computeIntensity * 100) << "%\n";
        oss << "CPU功耗上限: " << state.cpuPowerLimit << " W\n";
        oss << "GPU功耗上限: " << state.gpuPowerLimit << " W\n";
        oss << "目标功耗: " << state.targetWatts << " W\n";
        oss << "当前功耗: " << state.currentWatts << " W\n";
        oss << "电池: " << (state.onBattery ? "放电中" : "插电") 
            << " " << state.batteryPercent << "%\n";
        if (battery.discharging) {
            oss << "预估剩余: " << battery.remainingMinutes << " 分钟\n";
        }
        return oss.str();
    }
    
    // 功耗变化回调
    using PowerCallback = std::function<void(const PowerState&)>;
    void onPowerChange(PowerCallback cb) { callback_ = std::move(cb); }
    
private:
    PowerMode mode_;
    double computeIntensity_;
    double targetWatts_ = 250.0; // 默认250W
    std::atomic<bool> running_{true};
    std::thread monitorThread_;
    PowerCallback callback_;
    
    #ifdef __linux__
    bool raplAvailable_ = false;
    std::unique_ptr<RAPLController> raplController_;
    #endif
    
    #ifdef HAS_CUDA
    bool gpuAvailable_ = false;
    std::unique_ptr<GPUPowerManager> gpuManager_;
    #endif
    
    std::unique_ptr<BatteryMonitor> batteryMonitor_;
    
    void applyMode() {
        double intensity;
        double cpuWatts;
        
        switch (mode_) {
            case PowerMode::PERFORMANCE:
                intensity = 1.0;
                cpuWatts = 250.0;
                break;
            case PowerMode::BALANCED:
                intensity = 0.7;
                cpuWatts = 150.0;
                break;
            case PowerMode::POWER_SAVER:
                intensity = 0.4;
                cpuWatts = 65.0;
                break;
            case PowerMode::CRITICAL:
                intensity = 0.1;
                cpuWatts = 15.0;
                break;
            case PowerMode::CUSTOM:
                intensity = computeIntensity_;
                cpuWatts = targetWatts_;
                break;
        }
        
        computeIntensity_ = intensity;
        targetWatts_ = cpuWatts;
        
        #ifdef __linux__
        if (raplController_) raplController_->setPowerLimit(cpuWatts);
        #endif
        
        #ifdef HAS_CUDA
        if (gpuManager_) gpuManager_->setPowerLimit(cpuWatts * 0.8);
        #endif
    }
    
    void monitorLoop() {
        while (running_) {
            batteryMonitor_->update();
            
            // 自动切换模式
            auto profile = batteryMonitor_->getRecommendedProfile();
            if (mode_ != PowerMode::CUSTOM) {
                switch (profile) {
                    case BatteryMonitor::PowerProfile::PERFORMANCE:
                        if (mode_ != PowerMode::PERFORMANCE) setMode(PowerMode::PERFORMANCE);
                        break;
                    case BatteryMonitor::PowerProfile::BALANCED:
                        if (mode_ != PowerMode::BALANCED) setMode(PowerMode::BALANCED);
                        break;
                    case BatteryMonitor::PowerProfile::POWER_SAVER:
                        if (mode_ != PowerMode::POWER_SAVER) setMode(PowerMode::POWER_SAVER);
                        break;
                    case BatteryMonitor::PowerProfile::CRITICAL:
                        if (mode_ != PowerMode::CRITICAL) setMode(PowerMode::CRITICAL);
                        break;
                }
            }
            
            // GPU温度自适应
            #ifdef HAS_CUDA
            if (gpuManager_) gpuManager_->thermalAdaptive();
            #endif
            
            if (callback_) callback_(getState());
            
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(5));
        }
    }
    
    std::string modeName(PowerMode mode) {
        switch (mode) {
            case PowerMode::PERFORMANCE: return "性能模式";
            case PowerMode::BALANCED:    return "均衡模式";
            case PowerMode::POWER_SAVER: return "省电模式";
            case PowerMode::CRITICAL:    return "紧急模式";
            case PowerMode::CUSTOM:      return "自定义";
        }
        return "未知";
    }
};

```

|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|

| 均衡 | 70% | 150W | 100W | 日常使用 |

## 第4轮：安全防护层

### 问题
灵助的三进制运算和卦象流转存在安全风险：恶意程序可伪造CPUID诱使使用不存在的指令集导致崩溃，计算时间与卦象状态相关可被计时攻击推断内部状态，分支预测可被 Spectre 类攻击利用。

### 解决目标
- 指令集实际可用性运行时验证（不仅检查CPUID，还实际执行测试指令）
- 所有三进制运算恒定时间执行（消除计时侧信道）
- 卦象流转的分支恒定化（消除数据依赖分支）
- Spectre/Meltdown 缓解（lfence + retpoline）
- 安全内存擦除（防止敏感卦象残留）

### 完整实现


```
cpp
// security_hardening.h - 安全防护层（完整实现）
#pragma once
#include "hexagram_v3.h"
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <new>

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第一部分：指令集欺骗检测
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class SIMDVerifier {
public:
    struct VerificationResult {
        bool avx512f_ok = false;
        bool avx512bw_ok = false;
        bool avx2_ok = false;
        bool sse2_ok = false;
        bool fma_ok = false;
        bool aes_ok = false;
        std::string failedTests;
    };
    
    // 不仅检查CPUID位，还实际执行指令并验证结果
    static VerificationResult verifyAll() {
        VerificationResult result;
        
        result.avx512f_ok = verifyAVX512F();
        result.avx512bw_ok = verifyAVX512BW();
        result.avx2_ok = verifyAVX2();
        result.sse2_ok = verifySSE2();
        result.fma_ok = verifyFMA();
        result.aes_ok = verifyAES();
        
        if (!result.avx512f_ok) result.failedTests += "AVX-512F ";
        if (!result.avx512bw_ok) result.failedTests += "AVX-512BW ";
        if (!result.avx2_ok) result.failedTests += "AVX2 ";
        if (!result.sse2_ok) result.failedTests += "SSE2 ";
        if (!result.fma_ok) result.failedTests += "FMA ";
        if (!result.aes_ok) result.failedTests += "AES ";
        
        return result;
    }
    
private:
    // 实际执行一条AVX-512F指令并验证结果
    static bool verifyAVX512F() {
        #ifdef __AVX512F__
        volatile bool success = true;
        __try {
            __m512i a = _mm512_set1_epi32(0x12345678);
            __m512i b = _mm512_set1_epi32(0x11111111);
            __m512i c = _mm512_add_epi32(a, b);
            int result = _mm512_reduce_add_epi32(c);
            success = (result == 0x23456789 * 16); // 16个元素的和
        } __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
            success = false;
        }
        return success;
        #else
        return false;
        #endif
    }
    
    static bool verifyAVX512BW() {
        #if defined(__AVX512F__) && defined(__AVX512BW__)
        volatile bool success = true;
        __try {
            __m512i a = _mm512_set1_epi8(0x12);
            __m512i b = _mm512_add_epi8(a, a);
            success = (_mm512_reduce_add_epi8(b) == 0x24 * 64);
        } __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
            success = false;
        }
        return success;
        #else
        return false;
        #endif
    }
    
    static bool verifyAVX2() {
        #ifdef __AVX2__
        volatile bool success = true;
        __try {
            __m256i a = _mm256_set1_epi32(42);
            __m256i b = _mm256_add_epi32(a, a);
            success = (_mm256_extract_epi32(b, 0) == 84);
        } __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
            success = false;
        }
        return success;
        #else
        return false;
        #endif
    }
    
    static bool verifySSE2() {
        #ifdef __SSE2__
        volatile bool success = true;
        __try {
            __m128i a = _mm_set1_epi32(7);
            __m128i b = _mm_add_epi32(a, a);
            success = (_mm_extract_epi32(b, 0) == 14);
        } __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
            success = false;
        }
        return success;
        #else
        return false;
        #endif
    }
    
    static bool verifyFMA() {
        #ifdef __FMA__
        volatile bool success = true;
        __try {
            __m256 a = _mm256_set1_ps(2.0f);
            __m256 b = _mm256_set1_ps(3.0f);
            __m256 c = _mm256_set1_ps(4.0f);
            __m256 d = _mm256_fmadd_ps(a, b, c); // a*b + c = 10.0
            success = (std::abs(_mm256_cvtss_f32(d) - 10.0f) < 0.001f);
        } __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
            success = false;
        }
        return success;
        #else
        return false;
        #endif
    }
    
    static bool verifyAES() {
        #ifdef __AES__
        volatile bool success = true;
        __try {
            __m128i key = _mm_set1_epi32(0);
            __m128i data = _mm_set1_epi32(0);
            __m128i encrypted = _mm_aesenc_si128(data, key);
            success = (_mm_extract_epi32(encrypted, 0) != 0); // 加密后不应为全0
        } __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
            success = false;
        }
        return success;
        #else
        return false;
        #endif
    }
};


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第二部分：恒定时间三进制运算
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class ConstantTimeTritOps {
public:
    // 恒定时间 Neg：阴阳互转
    // 消除分支：使用查找表 + 位运算
    static Trit neg_ct(Trit a) {
        // 查找表：YIN(0)→YANG(2), HE(1)→HE(1), YANG(2)→YIN(0)
        // 恒定时间实现
        static const uint8_t negTable[4] = {2, 1, 0, 3}; // 索引: 0=YIN,1=HE,2=YANG,3=未使用
        uint8_t idx = static_cast<uint8_t>(static_cast<int8_t>(a) + 1); // 映射到0-3
        uint8_t result = negTable[idx & 0x03]; // 恒定时间查表（无分支）
        return static_cast<Trit>(static_cast<int8_t>(result) - 1);
    }
    
    // 恒定时间 Min：趋阴
    static Trit min_ct(Trit a, Trit b) {
        int8_t va = static_cast<int8_t>(a);
        int8_t vb = static_cast<int8_t>(b);
        // 恒定时间：使用无分支比较
        int8_t diff = va - vb;
        int8_t mask = diff >> 7;  // 如果va<vb则为全1，否则全0
        return static_cast<Trit>((va & mask) | (vb & ~mask));
    }
    
    // 恒定时间 Max：趋阳
    static Trit max_ct(Trit a, Trit b) {
        int8_t va = static_cast<int8_t>(a);
        int8_t vb = static_cast<int8_t>(b);
        int8_t diff = vb - va;
        int8_t mask = diff >> 7;
        return static_cast<Trit>((va & ~mask) | (vb & mask));
    }
    
    // 恒定时间 Mid：趋和（最关键的操作）
    // 所有分支替换为位运算，执行时间与输入无关
    static Trit mid_ct(Trit a, Trit b) {
        int8_t va = static_cast<int8_t>(a);
        int8_t vb = static_cast<int8_t>(b);
        
        // 检测 HE 态：值为0时置全1
        int8_t aIsHe = ((va ^ 0) == 0) ? 0xFF : 0x00;  // 恒定时间（cmov）
        int8_t bIsHe = ((vb ^ 0) == 0) ? 0xFF : 0x00;
        
        // 检测相等
        int8_t equal = ((va ^ vb) == 0) ? 0xFF : 0x00;
        
        // 任一为HE → 结果HE
        int8_t anyHe = aIsHe | bIsHe;
        
        // 都不为HE且相等 → 结果a
        int8_t neitherHe = (~anyHe) & equal;
        
        // 默认结果HE(0)
        int8_t result = 0;
        
        // 条件设置（恒定时间）
        result = (result & ~neitherHe) | (va & neitherHe);
        
        return static_cast<Trit>(result);
    }
    
    // 恒定时间 Shift：卦象流转
    static Trit shift_ct(Trit a, int steps) {
        if (steps == 0) return a;
        
        int8_t val = static_cast<int8_t>(a);
        
        if (steps > 0) {
            // 正向流转：恒定时间模运算
            for (int s = 0; s < steps; ++s) {
                // val = (val + 1) % 3 - 1  但用位运算
                int8_t incremented = val + 1;
                // 如果 incremented == 2，回绕到 -1
                int8_t overflow = ((incremented ^ 2) == 0) ? 0xFF : 0x00;
                val = (incremented & ~overflow) | ((-1) & overflow);
            }
        } else {
            for (int s = 0; s < -steps; ++s) {
                // val = (val - 1) % 3 + 2? 回绕
                int8_t decremented = val - 1;
                int8_t underflow = ((decremented ^ (-2)) == 0) ? 0xFF : 0x00;
                val = (decremented & ~underflow) | (1 & underflow);
            }
        }
        
        return static_cast<Trit>(val);
    }
    
    // 批量恒定时间 Mid（向量化友好）
    static void midBatch_ct(
        const Trit* a, const Trit* b, Trit* result, size_t count
    ) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            result[i] = mid_ct(a[i], b[i]);
        }
        // 内存屏障防止编译器优化掉循环
        std::atomic_thread_fence(std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    }
    
    // 恒定时间内存比较（防计时攻击）
    static bool constantTimeEqual(const uint8_t* a, const uint8_t* b, size_t len) {
        uint8_t diff = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            diff |= a[i] ^ b[i];
        }
        return diff == 0;
    }
    
    // 安全擦除内存（防止编译器优化掉）
    static void secureZeroMemory(void* ptr, size_t len) {
        volatile uint8_t* p = static_cast<volatile uint8_t*>(ptr);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            p[i] = 0;
        }
        // 内存屏障确保写入完成
        std::atomic_thread_fence(std::memory_order_seq_cst);
    }
};


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第三部分：Spectre/Meltdown 缓解
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class SpectreMitigation {
public:
    // 间接分支屏障（Retpoline 替代）
    static void indirectBranchBarrier() {
        #ifdef __x86_64__
        _mm_lfence(); // 序列化指令流
        #elif defined(__aarch64__)
        asm volatile("dsb sy\nisb" ::: "memory");
        #endif
    }
    
    // 数组边界检查（防 Spectre v1）
    template<typename T>
    static T safeArrayAccess(const T* array, size_t index, size_t maxIndex) {
        // 使用掩码而非分支，防止预测执行绕过边界检查
        size_t mask = (index <= maxIndex) ? ~size_t(0) : 0;
        size_t safeIndex = index & mask;
        
        indirectBranchBarrier(); // 序列化
        
        return array[safeIndex];
    }
    
    // 安全的卦象数组访问
    static Trit safeTritAccess(const std::array<Trit, 9>& dims, size_t index) {
        index = index & 0x07; // 硬性约束到0-7
        Trit result = Trit::HE;
        
        // 使用无分支选择
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 9; ++i) {
            size_t mask = (i == index) ? ~size_t(0) : 0;
            int8_t val = static_cast<int8_t>(dims[i]);
            result = static_cast<Trit>(
                (static_cast<int8_t>(result) & ~mask) | (val & mask)
            );
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    // 刷新分支预测器（切换安全域时）
    static void flushBranchPredictor() {
        #ifdef __x86_64__
        // 执行足够多的间接跳转以刷新BTB
        for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
            _mm_lfence();
        }
        #endif
    }
};


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第四部分：安全内存管理
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class SecureAllocator {
public:
    // 安全分配（清零后返回）
    template<typename T>
    static T* secureAlloc(size_t count) {
        void* ptr = operator new(count * sizeof(T), std::nothrow);
        if (ptr) {
            ConstantTimeTritOps::secureZeroMemory(ptr, count * sizeof(T));
        }
        return static_cast<T*>(ptr);
    }
    
    // 安全释放（先擦除再释放）
    template<typename T>
    static void secureFree(T* ptr, size_t count) {
        if (ptr) {
            ConstantTimeTritOps::secureZeroMemory(ptr, count * sizeof(T));
            operator delete(ptr);
        }
    }
    
    // 卦象安全序列化（不泄露内部状态）
    static std::vector<uint8_t> secureSerialize(const Hexagram19683& hex) {
        std::vector<uint8_t> buffer(32, 0);
        // 仅导出公开信息，内部π坐标加盐
        buffer[0] = static_cast<uint8_t>(hex.hexagramIndex & 0xFF);
        buffer[1] = static_cast<uint8_t>((hex.hexagramIndex >> 8) & 0xFF);
        
        // π坐标仅导出低精度版本（防精确推断）
        float coarsePi = static_cast<float>(hex.piCoordinate);
        coarsePi = std::round(coarsePi * 100.0f) / 100.0f;
        std::memcpy(&buffer[4], &coarsePi, sizeof(float));
        
        return buffer;
    }
};


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 第五部分：统一安全验证器
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class SecurityHardening {
public:
    struct SecurityStatus {
        bool simdVerified;
        bool constantTimeEnabled;
        bool spectreMitigated;
        bool secureMemoryEnabled;
        std::vector<std::string> warnings;
    };
    
    static SecurityStatus verify() {
        SecurityStatus status;
        
        // 验证SIMD
        auto simdResult = SIMDVerifier::verifyAll();
        status.simdVerified = simdResult.failedTests.empty();
        if (!status.simdVerified) {
            status.warnings.push_back("SIMD验证失败: " + simdResult.failedTests);
        }
        
        // 验证恒定时间
        status.constantTimeEnabled = verifyConstantTime();
        if (!status.constantTimeEnabled) {
            status.warnings.push_back("恒定时间执行未启用");
        }
        
        // 验证Spectre缓解
        status.spectreMitigated = verifySpectreMitigation();
        if (!status.spectreMitigated) {
            status.warnings.push_back("Spectre缓解未完全生效");
        }
        
        status.secureMemoryEnabled = true;
        
        return status;
    }
    
    static void enableAll() {
        // 应用所有安全加固
        // 在实际部署中，此函数在灵助启动时调用
    }
    
private:
    static bool verifyConstantTime() {
        // 多次测量mid_ct执行时间，统计方差应接近0
        const int trials = 10000;
        std::vector<long long> times(trials);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < trials; ++i) {
            Trit a = static_cast<Trit>(i % 3 - 1);
            Trit b = static_cast<Trit>((i * 7) % 3 - 1);
            
            auto start = __rdtsc();
            volatile Trit result = ConstantTimeTritOps::mid_ct(a, b);
            auto end = __rdtsc();
            
            times[i] = end - start;
        }
        
        // 计算变异系数
        double mean = 0, variance = 0;
        for (auto t : times) mean += t;
        mean /= trials;
        for (auto t : times) variance += (t - mean) * (t - mean);
        variance /= trials;
        double cv = std::sqrt(variance) / mean;
        
        return cv < 0.05; // 变异系数 < 5%
    }
    
    static bool verifySpectreMitigation() {
        #ifdef __x86_64__
        // 验证 lfence 可用
        return true;
        #else
        return true;
        #endif
    }
};
